serverCert.title: Import Server Certificate
serverCert.desc: For domains whose private key you own, import the real server certificate and key. Sniffy presents it during MITM instead of its own forged certificate, so certificate-pinning clients pass validation with no client-side changes. The matching domains are read from the certificate itself (SAN/CN) — no need to type them in. It only takes effect for domains within the HTTPS decryption scope; tunneled (out-of-scope) hosts are not intercepted. Only useful when you own the server (hold its certificate private key).
serverCert.fieldsRequired: Please provide both the certificate and the private key.

androidHelp.proxyBody: In the current Wi-Fi network details, look for <m>Edit network</m>, <m>Modify network</m>, or <m>Advanced options</m>, then find <m>Proxy</m>. The location varies by manufacturer and Android version.
androidHelp.findSettings: If you cannot find the installer, search Settings for <m>Credentials</m>, or look under <m>Security</m> or <m>More security settings</m>. Menu names vary by manufacturer and Android version.

androidHelp.appBody: Apps targeting Android 7 or later do not trust user CAs by default. For an app you develop, use this configuration to trust user certificates in debug builds. If a configuration already exists, merge <c>debug-overrides</c> into that file.

guideDialog.rootDescription: Install and trust this certificate to let Sniffy decrypt HTTPS requests and responses on your device.

windows-store.title: Choose the store
windows-store.body: Set the location to <m>Local Machine</m> and the store to <m>Trusted Root Certification Authorities</m>.

macos-download.title: Download the certificate
macos-download.body: Save <c>sniffy-ca.crt</c> and double-click it to add it to <m>Keychain Access</m>.

macos-find.title: Find the certificate
macos-find.body: In the <m>login</m> or <m>System</m> keychain, search for <c>Sniffy</c> and double-click <c>Sniffy Self-Signed CA</c>.

macos-trust.title: Set to Always Trust
macos-trust.body: Expand <m>Trust</m> and set <m>When using this certificate</m> to <m>Always Trust</m>.

macos-auth.title: Confirm the change
macos-auth.body: Close the certificate window, enter your system password, then click <m>Update Settings</m>.

ios-proxy.title: Set the Wi-Fi proxy
ios-proxy.body:
<m>Settings</m> › <m>Wi-Fi</m> › current network <m>ⓘ</m> › <m>Configure Proxy</m>
Choose <m>Manual</m> and enter the values below.

ios-proxy-auth.title: Set the Wi-Fi proxy
ios-proxy-auth.body:
<m>Settings</m> › <m>Wi-Fi</m> › current network <m>ⓘ</m> › <m>Configure Proxy</m>
Choose <m>Manual</m>, enter the values below, then turn on <m>Authentication</m> with your Sniffy proxy credentials.

ios-download.title: Download the profile
ios-download.body: Scan the QR code with the camera, open it in Safari, and tap <m>Allow</m>.

ios-install.title: Install the profile
ios-install.body:
<m>Settings</m> › <m>General</m> › <m>VPN & Device Management</m>
Select <c>Sniffy Root CA</c>, tap <m>Install</m>, then enter your device passcode and follow the prompts to finish installing.

ios-trust.title: Turn on full trust
ios-trust.body:
<m>Settings</m> › <m>General</m> › <m>About</m> › <m>Certificate Trust Settings</m>
Turn on <c>Sniffy Self-Signed CA</c>.

android-proxy.title: Set the Wi-Fi proxy
android-proxy.body:
Open the current Wi-Fi network details and find <m>Proxy</m>.
Choose <m>Manual</m> and enter the values below.

android-download.title: Scan to download the certificate
android-download.body:
Scan the QR code with your phone and download <c>sniffy-ca.crt</c> in a browser.
You can also enter the download URL in your phone’s browser.

android-install.title: Install the CA certificate
android-install.body:
In <m>Settings</m>, search for <m>Install a certificate</m> or <m>CA certificate</m>.
Choose <m>CA certificate</m> and import <c>sniffy-ca.crt</c>.
Android 11 and later usually require manual installation from Settings.

firefox-manager.title: Open the Certificate Manager
firefox-manager.legacy: Page not found? On older Firefox, open <c>about:preferences#privacy</c> and click <m>View Certificates</m> under <m>Certificates</m>.

firefox-import.title: Import and trust
firefox-import.body:
<m>Authorities</m> tab › <m>Import</m>
Choose <c>sniffy-ca.crt</c>, check <m>Trust this CA to identify websites</m>, then click <m>OK</m>.

firefox-proxy.title: Set the proxy
firefox-proxy.body:
Open <c>about:preferences#connectionSecurity</c> and open the proxy settings.
Choose <m>Use system proxy settings</m>, or enter <c>{{host}}</c> port <c>{{port}}</c> manually and check <m>Also use this proxy for HTTPS</m>.
